description: The map the rover has built from its own sensors only (not the true layout): an occupancy grid of 10 px cells as ASCII rows ("#" occupied by a sonar/IR echo or bumper hit, "." free, " " unknown, "@" rover, a capital letter = floor color read by a color sensor), camera landmarks with estimated world x/y, bumper hit points, the pose and exploration stats. clear=true wipes the map first.

clear.description: Clear the map before returning it (default false)

name: get_sensor_map
title: Get sensor map
